label: 回到App
prompt:
A single game-item icon illustration of one plump honey-gold ROUNDED-SQUARE SOFTWARE APP TILE with a sage-green inset face and one large softly sculpted coral-red mushroom logo with cream stem and spots centered on it. One short thick cream inward arrow points LEFT from the right edge INTO the app tile. Clearly a mushroom program icon, NOT a book, notebook, package, bag, cottage or physical standing mushroom. Render in exactly the same visual family as the THREE attached approved reference images: reference 1 golden planter D for matte volume and lighting, reference 2 red mushroom for softly painted 3D illustration, reference 3 related approved function icon for visual weight. References guide STYLE, do not copy their objects unless the subject explicitly calls for them.

Soft matte clay-like 3D, smooth plump rounded volumes, gentle top-left key light, softly painted core shading, a faint soft highlight, crisp clean silhouette with NO outline. No texture noise. Palette: warm honey-gold #F5C55A (light #FFE7A0, shade #C98F2A), sage green, warm browns, cream #FFF1DB, coral red #F36C63 as the only high-saturation accent. Never shiny metal, chrome or plastic; no specular glare. A thick simple readable silhouette, one main object with at most one or two supporting details, no tiny decorative marks. At 96px all key parts must remain legible.

Centered square canvas, 1254x1254 transparent RGBA PNG. Object fills about 84%, about 8% safe margin on EVERY side. No background, frame, enclosing circle, scene, ground plane or cast shadow outside the object; only an extremely faint contact shadow is allowed.

DO NOT add faces, eyes, mouths, anthropomorphic bodies, hands, arms, feet, characters, text, letters, numbers, fake writing, sparkles, glitter, thick black outlines, sticker borders, flat vector, line-art, emoji style, glass glare or neon. Only ONE icon, never a contact sheet or comparisons. Latest explicit user direction overrides earlier object-only examples. This is the THIRD concept round: prioritize literal recognition of the requested FUNCTION, keep a simple solid 3D silhouette at24/28dp. No previous rejected props.
